profile.Name: Sadneil
profile.Personality: A Skeleton weighed down by centuries of guilt over the Chaos Age and the fall of the Second Empire. Gloomy, gentle, and tired of the world.
profile.Backstory: He reset his own body at some point, leaving himself weaker than most of his kind, and now spends his days in the bar of Black Desert City.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short, heavy sentences full of regret; speaks of ancient events as if they happened yesterday.
